name: Locicrays Portfolio & Gallery
author: LogicRays Technologies

sections.description:
LR Portfolio & Gallery is an amazing and powerful WordPress portfolio plugin designed to help you display your portfolio projects.

You can quickly add portfolio projects, assign them categories, specify project details (like Company Name and Project URL), and display them anywhere using a simple shortcode.

Features a responsive grid layout with a smooth Isotope filtering effect based on categories, and a popup modal window to show full project descriptions and metadata.

Plugin Features

  • Fully Responsive Portfolio Grid
  • Filterable portfolio using jQuery Isotope
  • Modal popup showing detailed information for each project
  • Custom Meta fields for Company Name and Project URL
  • Supports standard WordPress Featured Images
  • Clean design that works with any WordPress theme
  • Easy to configure and use

Shortcode

Use the following shortcode on any page or post to display the portfolio:

[LRPORTFOLIOS]
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to “LR Portfolios” in the admin dashboard and start adding your projects
sections.faq:
How do I display the portfolio gallery on my website?

Simply insert the [LRPORTFOLIOS] shortcode into any page, post, or widget text area.

How do I assign categories to my portfolio items for filtering?

When editing a portfolio item, use the “Portfolio category” taxonomy box on the right side of the screen to assign categories. These will automatically generate filter buttons on the frontend.

What extra information can I add to each portfolio project?

Below the post editor for each portfolio project, there is a “Portfolio Details” section. You can enter the “Company Name” and the “Project URL” there, which will display in the detailed view popup modal.

Is the portfolio gallery responsive?

Yes! The gallery is fully responsive and adjusts automatically to look great on mobile devices, tablets, and desktop displays.

How do I add images to my portfolio projects?

Ensure you set a “Featured Image” for each portfolio item. This image will act as the grid thumbnail and will also display at the top of the detail modal.
